test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per Census 2001 report, from which country does India receive most number of migrants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **More than half **of **all remittances **to **India **in **recent years **have **come from the six Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) nations**:

 
 
• Bahrain.
 
• Kuwait.
 
• Oman.
 
• Qatar.
 
• Saudi Arabia.
 
• The United Arab Emirates.
 
• Nearly **one-fifth **of the **money sent to India **as **remittances **came **from the United States**.
 
 
 
• According to the **most current census of 2011**, there were **450 million internal migrants in India**.
 
• This **represents a 45% increase over the 309 million figures from 2001**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Human migration is the movement of individuals from one location to another with the aim of relocating, either permanently or temporarily.
